title: Minimum Total Price After Applying Discounts
summary: Assign percentage discounts to items to minimize the total price. Each discount and each item may participate in at most one assignment; leaving an item undiscounted is allowed. Discount d changes price p to p*(100-d)/100 without rounding. Return the minimum total.
officialConstraints: Both arrays have 1..100000 entries; prices 1..100000; percentages 1..100.
Answers accepted within 0.00001 of the actual value.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
